detail.name: Gold Term Deposit
detail.description:
A Bendigo Gold Term Deposit Account is a deposit account that allows a retail client to deposit $2,000 or more into it for 
a 12 month investment period with interest payable every 3 months at an agreed rate. Funds can be reinvested or 
withdrawn, however any withdrawal greater than 25% of the value of the initial deposit requires the client to provide 
notice. Funds released early may attract a reduced interest rate.

features.additionalInfo: *Existing customers only

detail.name: Fixed Rate Farm Management Deposit
detail.description: A Farm Management Deposit (FMD) is an important cash flow management tool that enables individuals carrying on a primary production business in Australia (primary producers) to set aside pre-tax income from their profitable years and earn interest on it – so the money’s available when they most need it.

features.additionalInfo: Fixed 1, 2, 3, 6, 12 or 24 month terms available.
Designed for primary producers who’ve earned a taxable non-farm income of $100,000 or less over a financial year.
You can have more than one Farm Management Deposit, up to a combined value of $800,000 per farmer.
Earn competitive interest rates on a choice of fixed terms.
No monthly account service fees or transaction fees apply to Bendigo Bank Farm Management Deposit accounts.
31 day withdrawal notice if need to access funds before its maturity date.

constraints.additionalInfo: The total of all FMD’s held in a client’s name must not exceed $800,000.00

eligibility.additionalInfo: Customer must be a primary producer with an off-farm taxable income of less than $100,000 per annum.
Only available to Australian primary producers.
Can only be opened in the name of an individual.
Subject to farm management deposit scheme eligibility guidelines.
